purpose: library: DNA structure and function — deoxyribonucleic acid as the hereditary material in humans and almost all other organisms, present in nearly every cell; the code of four chemical bases adenine (A), guanine (G), cytosine (C) and thymine (T); human DNA's about 3 billion bases with more than 99 percent identical in all people; base sequence as the information for building and maintaining an organism; base pairing (A with T, C with G) forming base pairs, each base attached to a sugar and a phosphate (the sugar-phosphate backbone) in the double helix; and replication (each strand as a template for copying). Fits quiz cards with predict-then-reveal on the numbers (4 bases, ~3 billion, >99 percent), a compare table of the base pairings, and step ordering of replication. Carries a labelled DNA-structure figure (not stored).
